description: Quick single token swap with best execution across DEXes (Uniswap V3, Aerodrome). Compares quotes from multiple routes and executes on the best one. Returns tx hash, amounts, price impact, and gas used.

amount.description: Amount to swap in human-readable form (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 ETH)

confirm.description: Set true to execute. False returns quote comparison only.

from_token.description: Token to sell: symbol (ETH, USDC, WETH) or contract address

slippage_bps.description: Max slippage in basis points (100 = 1%). Default: 100

to_token.description: Token to buy: symbol (ETH, USDC, WETH) or contract address

name: defi_quick_swap
